CustomField.description: Number of months MRC billing is deferred. Passed in IP-1 to Odoo. Free_Months__c > 0 triggers SBI_Flag__c. Free_Months__c > 3 also triggers Deal Review.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Number of months where MRC billing is waived at the start of the contract. Any value above 0 triggers an SBI flag; above 3 months also triggers Deal Review approval.
CustomField.label: Free Months (MRC Waiver)
